comments:
636c7922: This program is used for printing Deficiency Reports by various sort orders.
It processes entries from the ^UTILITY global and formats output for display or printing.
c75583a6: Main loop: process each division until done or user quits.
37279c90: Check if user quit; if not, and there are entries, proceed to final report section.
d369f82d: Exit point for the report routine.
6df5e732: Set the current division for processing.
d371b161: Set division delete flag if applicable and print division name.
0c4b0f31: End of the DIV subroutine.
6dfbbb5f: Format and print the report date.
e7f8cbc4: Loop through patients within a division for report section.
b5bc8a8d: End of the PAT subroutine.
f875333d: For each patient, process and print individual deficiency records.
124d8136: End of the PAT1 subroutine.
f1034ebb: Print header for the physician section if first physician entry.
3b5c42c9: Loop through physicians within a division for report section.
c17d5ba7: End of the PHY subroutine.
7f8b8cf8: For each physician, process and print individual deficiency records, and perform additional checks.
b56b717c: End of the PHY1 subroutine.
b8218210: Loop through dates within a division for report section.
b9c0e9fc: End of the DAT subroutine.
b98ff8be: For each date, process and print individual deficiency records.
ebfbd5ab: End of the DAT1 subroutine.
3e1536fc: Print header for the service section if first service entry.
a7655fee: Loop through services within a division for report section.
0ba2dcfb: End of the SER subroutine.
d6617db5: Loop through specialties within a service for report section.
11a131f6: End of the SER1 subroutine.
33a4e404: For each specialty, process and print individual deficiency records and perform additional service checks.
7a193eb9: End of the SER2 subroutine.
713ebdf3: Begin processing a deficiency record for print.
7f8b1ef5: Set the physician's name; if not specified, label as 'NOT SPECIFIED'.
dae82564: If sorting by date, print the date at the start of the line.
51eb941d: If not sorting by date, just print a newline to start the new record.
bba8e23d: Print the truncated patient name.
21784192: Print the patient ID next to the patient name.
b6ced931: If not sorting by date, also print the date of the deficiency next to the patient ID.
49c3e337: Print the admission date and type of admission if available.
9c12b016: Print the service or clinic name if available.
7e9bee6f: Set up variables for retrieving the latest room-bed information.
9fdea31a: Print the latest room-bed information.
19d96c17: If sorting by physician, call the header print subroutine for the next section.
75ab1882: Print the physician's name or 'NOT SPECIFIED' if not available.
8ce9250a: Print the service section or 'NOT SPECIFIED' if not available.
86a83609: If directed, print the deficiency code.
dae8a684: Print the length of the deficiency.
60e3f8fe: End of the PRT2 subroutine.
d6ea2b92: Call the header print routine from DGJOPRT3.
8de076eb: Check for patient or date sorting and if not in interactive mode, proceed to RET1.
a14f80e5: Exit if in non-interactive mode (not a terminal).
00037f32: Fill to bottom of page for reports not in interactive mode.
c995fca9: Print division name, prompt for user input in interactive mode.
acc1a619: Read user input; allow to quit or continue based on input.
69ee2bb5: Handle page break logic for patient or date sorted reports.
247bc31b: General page break handling, for interactive mode and others.
950b3234: End of the RELP subroutine.
46d6f0f0: Print the division header.
c3bd9377: Print the physician name in the header.
9b900e45: Print the service name in the header.
b5e1125d: Print the specialty in the header.
4836a5ad: Call the PH subroutine from DGJOPRT3.
65513825: Call the SV subroutine from DGJOPRT3.
